hub.title: Assessment
hub.heading: Test how you make decisions
hub.body: Each package has chart scenarios on historical data and multiple-choice questions from the Learn 101 lessons. What gets scored is the process: the decision, the reasons, the risk, the stop loss, the target and how you close. Profit or loss is not part of the score.
hub.counts: {scenarios, plural, one {# scenario} other {# scenarios}} · {complex} complex MC · {basic} basic MC
hub.note: Results and packages in progress are kept on this device. All prices are historical; this is practice, not trading advice.

runner.intro: This package has {n} questions, taken in order. Scores and explanations appear only after the last one. In a scenario you decide first, then press Start: the next candles play on their own and can't be replayed.
runner.saved: You have an unfinished run of this package on this device. Continue from where you left off, or start over.

errors.problem: The decision is incomplete or not valid. Check what you entered.
errors.expired: This package's session has expired. Start again from the beginning.
errors.failed: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
errors.stale: This package just moved on in another tab. Reload the page to continue.
errors.unavailable: The assessment isn't available right now. Try again later.

mcq.pickMany: Pick every right answer (there can be more than one).

scenario.chartNote: Chart times are UTC (weekday and hour). The amber START line marks your decision point.
scenario.marketAt: A market order fills at the last close, {price}.
scenario.pendingHint: A pending order fills when price reaches your entry price. Price is now {price}.

problems.lot: Enter a lot of at least 0.01, in steps of 0.01.
problems.levels: Put the SL and TP on the right sides of the entry price.
problems.entry: Enter a pending entry price different from the current price.

scenario.startNote: After Start, the decision, SL and TP are locked. Candles play on their own at a fixed pace.

position.unfilled: The pending order was never reached

exit.auto: Closed automatically on the last candle, {price}
exit.manual: You closed it by hand at {price}

scenario.outcomeNote: Profit or loss here is not part of the score.
scenario.skipNote: If you skip, the position keeps running to its SL, TP or the last candle without being shown.
scenario.toolsNote: Lines, trendlines, rectangles, paths and indicators are analysis aids and aren't scored. The SL and TP from the BUY/SELL position tool are scored and lock after Start.
scenario.toolHint: Enter the SL and TP prices here, or use the BUY/SELL Position tool in the chart toolbar and drag its lines: these fields fill in.
scenario.toolLinked: Linked to the position tool on the chart: drag its lines or change the numbers here.

review.title: Review
review.principle: The score judges the process, never the profit or loss. A sound process still scores well when it hits the SL. No ranking, and no comparison with other users.
review.scenariosNote: Average of {n, plural, one {# scenario} other {# scenarios}}
review.aspectsNote: From the scenarios that use that aspect. NO TRADE scenarios score only the decision and reasons.
review.measureLine: Risk {risk, number}% · SL {sl, number} pips ({atr, number}× ATR) · R:R 1 : {rr, number}
review.decisionOnly: No position was opened, so only the decision and reasons are scored (times 5 for a 100 scale).
review.oneSample: This is one sample of what happened. It isn't part of the score: a good decision can lose, and a poor one can win by luck.
